reviews.title: A solid platform—with room for future upgrades
reviews.comment: It is a very good option for a mid-range build, offering excellent support for future upgrades to high-end components. It provides solid support for cooling and SSDs, and the inclusion of Wi-Fi 7 is another strong point; overall, it is an excellent choice for making the leap into the high-end tier.

reviews.title: Very cool looking motherboard
reviews.comment: Perfect motherboard, this gaming motherboard is the one I have. It's very nice. I like the lighting. I also like the fact that it could be a little future-proof. It's an overall well-performing motherboard. The only thing that you have to do is make sure that you update the BIOS, and then it's easy to also overclock. And I think one of the issues I saw was that you can't play with DDR5s at 6500 as advertised. I guess they're having issues with that. So I just put an the bios at XP01 and set it to 6000 for the RAM.
